title: The Pokémon Company is hiring a full-time Pokémon Sleep illustrator
content: The Pokémon Company is hiring a full-time Pokémon Sleep illustrator! Dream job alert for Pokémon artists! The Pokémon Company has opened a full-time illustrator position focused on creating artwork for Pokémon Sleep. The role includes designing Pokémon sleeping poses using vector illustrations, creating in-game assets such as items, dishes, and environments, checking artwork quality, and directing external illustrators. Applicants need at least two years of professional vector illustration experience, proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, experience matching established character and IP art styles, and a background in the gaming or entertainment industry. The position is based at The Pokémon Company's headquarters in Roppongi, Tokyo, Japan. Think you've got what it takes to draw Pokémon dreams for a living? Apply at: https://hrmos.co/pages/pokemon/jobs/0000147
